title: Compute the saturated slack ideal of a square

source.citation: Antonio Macchia and Amy Wiebe, Slack Ideals in Macaulay2, arXiv:2003.07382

translation.notes: The square's symbolic slack matrix is entered directly. Noether computes its determinant and certifies that saturation by all eight variables leaves the published principal binomial ideal unchanged. General face-lattice-to-slack-matrix construction remains outside this case.
